verdict.rationale: Rootly documents generating API keys from Organization Settings. It also states that Global API Keys are assigned an On-Call and Incident Response role at generation, which suggests role-based permissions on keys and that other, non-global key types may exist. The evidence does not show how to restrict a key to least privilege or tie it to an agent such as the MCP server. Missing for 10: documented custom or fine-grained key scopes, non-global (team or personal) key types, per-agent or MCP-specific credential guidance, expiry or rotation controls, and independent corroboration.
